speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The handle was wet. That is the whole story, and it is not a good one.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am sorry, sir. It turned in my hand.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sorry will not put the chip back. Master Shakespeare, while you are on the stair. Firing and washing for the week is sixpence, and the board is threepence if you eat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will eat at noon. There is the sixpence, and the threepence with it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the board is paid, and I will see you at it. What are you ruling up there, that a pan can reach you?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A new leaf. It is still 1594. The Queen is in it for twenty pounds, not yet had.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Not yet had is not a dinner. You have paid this one. Keep the other in the book.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I bring the ink up, sir?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The horn is full. Leave it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then go back to the leaf. I have a pan to see to, and you have a year.
